name: GuttyPress – No-Code WordPress Toolkit for Designers – Free Theme & Full Site Editing
author: GuttyPress

sections.description:
The ultimate no-code solution for WordPress designers and creators, harnessing the power of the Block Editor and Full Site Editing (FSE) — all elevated by GuttyPress.

Transform your WordPress experience with GuttyPress, the all-in-one solution for WordPress designers and creators.
Build stunning, fast and fully responsive websites with ease—no coding required.

Why Choose GuttyPress?

  • Free Block-Based Theme: Get started with Gutty, a super lightweight WordPress theme tailored for Full Site Editing (FSE).
  • Full Compatibility: Built on WordPress core standards, GuttyPress ensures seamless integration with your favorite plugins and extensions.
  • Effortless Customization: Use our intuitive dashboard to create custom post types and taxonomies—no technical skills or developers needed.
  • Extreme Performance: GuttyPress is built with performance in mind, ensuring your site runs smoothly and efficiently.

Key Features

  • Wizard installation: Quickly get started building your WordPress site.
  • Animate any blocks: Each block can be animated without coding.
  • Blocks Visibility: Control the visibility of any blocks for mobile, tablet or desktop.
  • Custom Blocks: Gutty Slider, Gutty Back To Top and Gutty Marquee.
  • Theme options manager: Edit your theme options with our Theme options manager.
  • Custom Content Architecture: Effortlessly create and organize your content with our Post Types and Taxonomies manager.
  • Maintenance Mode: Quickly put your site in maintenance mode to prevent visitors from seeing your site while you work on it.
  • Custom Login Form: Create a custom login form with our Login Form manager.
  • Seamless Plugin Compatibility: Say goodbye to theme-extension conflicts. GuttyPress plays nicely with all your favorite WordPress plugins.
  • No-Code Solution: Perfect for beginners, designers, and professionals who want to focus on creativity—not coding.

GuttyPress PRO: Save time and money!

  • Premium Patterns library: Access stunning patterns to easily create your site.
  • Premium Templates library: Beautiful templates to quickly create amazing landing pages.
  • Premium support by mail: Get support by mail from your customer account.

Who Is GuttyPress For?

GuttyPress is ideal for:

  • Designers who want complete creative freedom.
  • Beginners looking for a no-code solution to create stunning websites.
  • WordPress enthusiasts seeking a reliable, all-in-one toolkit for Full Site Editing.

Get Started Today!

With GuttyPress, you’re just a few clicks away from building incredible WordPress sites. Say goodbye to limitations and hello to unlimited design possibilities.
Download GuttyPress now and start unlocking the full potential of your WordPress site!

The GuttyPress products

  • GuttyPress
  • GuttyPress Premium Themes
  • Gutty theme
  • Gutty Related Posts

Any questions? Visit our website guttypress.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘guttypress’ to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Click on GuttyPress to get started.
sections.faq:
How do I get support?

For FREE users: <a href=”https://guttypress.com/support/>Support center
For PRO users: support by mail from their customer account.
